name: airbrake_sourcemaps_upload
title: Upload an Airbrake source map
description: Upload a LOCAL source map to an Airbrake project: reads file_path (see its constraints; anything else is rejected before any request) and POSTs it as multipart/form-data with name (the minified file URL it applies to) and optional pattern (SQL LIKE pattern for minified file URLs). Each call stores a new map (not idempotent); a failed upload is never re-sent automatically — if its error says it may have been applied, check airbrake_sourcemaps list before uploading again. Disabled when AIRBRAKE_READ_ONLY is set. Returns the raw Airbrake JSON payload — no data is removed.

file_path.description: Absolute local path to the source map. Must end in .map and resolve (symlinks followed) to a regular *.map file of at most 50 MiB containing source map v3 JSON.

name.description: Minified file URL or name this map applies to, e.g. https://cdn.example.com/app.min.js

pattern.description: Optional SQL LIKE pattern matching minified file URLs, e.g. %/app.min.js
